children: Overview
Hong Kong food and home care maker's FY revenue rose 5%
Profit for the year fell 3% as higher expenses offset gross profit gains
Company raised total annual dividend to HK$0.50 per share from HK$0.48
Outlook
Company expects operating conditions to remain demanding due to price competition and channel shifts
Lam Soon Hong Kong says it will concentrate resources on higher-impact opportunities across products and channels
Company plans selective investment in people, R+D, digitalisation, automation and manufacturing capability
Result Drivers
HIGHER INPUT COSTS - Co said sharp increases in petroleum-linked raw and packaging material costs, especially in Home Care, weighed on profit
CAUTIOUS CONSUMPTION - Co said subdued demand and channel shifts in Chinese Mainland and intensified price competition in Hong Kong affected performance
COST-SAVING INITIATIVES - Co implemented procurement improvements and structural cost-saving measures to offset commodity and operating-cost pressures
